title: Boundary-restriction vanishing in the open-injective proper argument
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring. Let B,D,C,E be schemes and p:B→D and r:C→E be proper, and let k:C→B and i:E→D be quasi-compact open immersions satisfying k≫p=r≫i. Let J be an injective module sheaf over the constant A-sheaf on C, and let w be an OpenProperClopenWitness p r k i, with the factors and immersion properties recorded in lem-sp-proetale-open-injective-proper-acyclic-geometry. If z is the canonical reduced closed complement of i, then z^*H^q(Rp_*(k_!J[0]))=0 for every positive natural number q. All operations are the ordinary uncompleted intrinsic constant-ring operations [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations, def-weil-extension-by-zero, def-sp-injective-resolutions]. No etale-origin assumption on J is made.

source.place: Docstring proof steps 4--7 of isZero_higherDirectImage_open_injective_of_proper; the Stacks 0F7B etale argument is only an analogue.

proof.text: Apply closed-restriction detection to the q-th higher direct image. It is enough to prove zero sections at affine weakly contractible tests all of whose points specialize into the reduced closed complement.

Use the published functorial K-injective resolution and the right-derived comparison. Exact evaluation at W commutes with homology. The direct-image section formula identifies the evaluated pushforward complex with the model resolution evaluated on B times_D W. Thus its q-th homology is the displayed object hypercohomology.

The local boundary-test hypercohomology statement gives zero for this group. Transport through the evaluation comparison and the singleFunctorIsoCompQ isomorphism. The detection theorem then gives zero closed restriction.

proof_origin.description: Q4: complete Lean assembly, including K-injective evaluation comparison; the generic closed-restriction detection theorem is fully proved from existing localization and specialization-unit code. One strictly local hypercohomology step remains as a named theorem; this is a one-hole decomposition, not net hole closure.

theorem isZero_boundaryRestriction_higherDirectImage_open_injective_of_proper
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {B D C E : Scheme.{u}} (p : B ⟶ D) (r : C ⟶ E)
    (k : C ⟶ B) (i : E ⟶ D)
    [IsProper p] [IsProper r]
    [IsOpenImmersion k] [QuasiCompact k]
    [IsOpenImmersion i] [QuasiCompact i]
    (hcomm : k ≫ p = r ≫ i)
    (J : proEtaleRingModules C (proEtaleConstantRing C A)) [Injective J]
    (w : OpenProperClopenWitness p r k i)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    IsZero ((proEtaleConstantRingPullback A i.closedComplement).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (proEtaleRingModules D (proEtaleConstantRing D A)) (q : ℤ)).obj
        ((proEtaleConstantDerivedDirectImage p A).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (proEtaleRingModules B (proEtaleConstantRing B A)) 0).obj
            ((sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero k A).obj J)))))
